fixed.explanation: TestTypeImpl._configure ignored a lock option. It now accepts a string or an array of strings and adds them to the current loading suite's _locks. That is the same place _describe puts locks from details, so tests in the group and nested groups pick them up. The lock stays scoped to the group where configure is called. I couldn't see Suite._locks, so I assumed it is a string[]. I didn't update the public typings in types/test.d.ts, utils/generate_types/overrides-test.d.ts or the docs, because that code wasn't shown.
